2610.12299.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
2610.12299.paper_summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.
2610.12299.paper_summary_zh: 自我中心的世界模型預測基於代理行動的第一人稱觀察，但大多數模型專注於單一代理。真實的具身環境通常涉及多個代理在共享環境中行動和互動。現有的多代理世界模型依賴於粗略的行動，如運動、相機控制或離散命令，導致細緻的具身互動未被充分探索。我們將多代理自我中心世界建模定義為多個代理通過細緻行動在共享世界中同步生成自我流。這需要跨視角的行動一致性、共享環境的一致性，以及互動引起的狀態更新的一致傳播。我們提出了多代理自我中心世界模型（ME-World），該模型在共享的標記序列中共同去噪多個自我流，並將每個流的條件設定在所有代理的目標視角姿勢上，並用共享環境記憶來支持生成。我們在真實和合成的多代理數據上進行訓練和評估，並引入共享世界一致性度量來測量環境、一致更新和身份一致性。實驗表明，ME-World在共享世界一致性、行動控制、身份保留和視頻質量上優於現有方法。
